budget_semantics.max_additional_rounds: additional retrieval rounds AFTER the initial retrieval (initial round is not counted)
budget_semantics.max_cumulative_unique_documents: cumulative count of UNIQUE candidate documents across all rounds
budget_semantics.max_total_retriever_executions: total individual retriever calls (one dense search = 1, one BM25 search = 1), initial round included
budget_semantics.max_generator_context_tokens: hard limit on the final context sent to the generator; overflow is resolved by dropping lowest-evidence passages, never by truncating a requirement
budget_semantics.max_requirements: cap on planner output; exceeding it fails validation and triggers the documented fallback

parameter_provenance.budget: implementation_choice (engineering limits, frozen before final runs)
